name: New Creation
overview: The concept of the new creation in Scripture reveals the transformative power of faith in Christ, where believers are renewed and made into new creatures, no longer defined by former identities but by their relationship with Him. This transformation involves a renewing of the mind and putting on the new self, created in the image of God, as emphasized in passages like Romans 12:2 and Colossians 3:10. Salvation is by grace through faith, not by human effort, and calling on the name of the Lord brings this new life, as Romans 10:13 and Ephesians 2:8 affirm. Ultimately, the new creation centers on Christ’s work, making external distinctions irrelevant and focusing on the inward renewal that aligns believers with God's will and image.
